summary.text: Bryan Hopkins is the Republican candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 19A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Monica Church.
A certified public accountant and financial planner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he would focus on a balanced state budget, preserving open space, education and the local economy.

paragraphs.text: Bryan Hopkins earned a high school diploma from California High School and a bachelor's degree from California State University in 1989.
In a Ballotpedia survey he said he was a self-supported college student who earned a business degree from California State University, Fullerton.
He said that for most of his career he has been self-employed as a CPA and financial planner, and that he has also worked as an adjunct college professor.

He listed community involvement that includes a church finance committee, the Active 20/30 Club, Kiwanis, volunteer ski patrol and a scholarship at the Boise State University College of Business and Economics.
